OWL Basics

Released Oct 16, 2024, 10 min

Play OWL Basics on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

We know what ontologies are, but how do we build them? In this video, we'll walk through the basics of OWL. OWL sentences are triples, and those triples require us to uses certain "parts of speech". By the end of this video, you will know how to spot those parts of speech and be well on your way to creating your own triples!
